name: Persian VTT (Virtual Tabletop)
description: A lightweight, modern virtual tabletop web platform inspired by Owlbear Rodeo tailored for Persian RPG and D&D players with interactive Konva canvas, tokens with dynamic health bars, status effect indicators (Prone, Invisible, Incapacitated), role-based visibility, fog of war, measurement rulers, 3D animated physics dice rolling, and real-time synchronization.
